task.title: Compose selected skills into durable task tool turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/664 by retaining explicit caller policy and selected skills across bounded attempt-producing provider and tool continuations.
acceptance_criteria: Reject duplicate or absent skill selections before durable, provider, authorization, or tool side effects.
Preserve exact policy, selected skill blocks, transcript lineage, and in-memory tool results across opaque task scoped continuations.
Require fresh invocation identity and authorization for each requested tool and persist metadata-only invocation evidence.
Commit final assistant content followed by an exact Attempt while leaving existing skill-free runtime operations unchanged.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused composed tool task target failed because no durable composed task outcome, initial operation, or continuation operation existed.
attempts.patch: Added tests for selection preflight, exact authority retention, authorization, invocation evidence, provider observations, multi-step continuation, and final Attempt ordering.

attempts.summary: Implemented bounded attempt-producing composed task orchestration.
attempts.diagnostic: Opaque task scoped continuations retained immutable composition and transcript context while the existing durable dispatch boundary preserved one-provider and at-most-one-tool work per explicit call.
attempts.patch: Added composed task outcomes and runtime entrypoints, reused observation-oriented persistence, documented the additive contract, and updated milestone status.

attempts.summary: Corrected stale documentation and audited a review-gate process failure.
attempts.diagnostic: Review found a stale statement claiming skills were unavailable to every durable task turn, which was fixed. A post-merge audit then confirmed the CodeRabbit status still reported Review rate limited, so the pull request had merged without the required conclusive exact-head review evidence.
attempts.patch: Narrowed the non-goal to skill-free paths, resolved the review thread, and recorded the merge-policy discrepancy transparently on pull request 665 rather than misclassifying the false-green status as substantive review.

outcome.summary: Durable task tool turns now preserve explicit selected-skill authority through caller-driven bounded continuations and append final provider content as exact Attempt evidence.

verification.command: Pull request 665 squash merge 0bec01adae683f35f3b0419cf164fcffe8e7eb75 and transparent review-gate audit at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/665#issuecomment-5095955693

lessons: A durable continuation must retain the originating task and exact transcript as well as policy and selected instructions.
Skill authority never grants tool capability; each tool request still needs fresh caller-owned identity and permission.
Final provider content becomes Attempt evidence only after continuation state is revalidated against durable state.
Documentation must distinguish additive composed operations from conservative skill-free defaults.
A successful-looking rate-limited review status is not substantive review evidence, and a mistaken merge must be recorded rather than normalized.
